name: Santa Fiora (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santa Fiora (two female figures on green) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Santa Fiora, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Santa Fiora arms — two female figures on green, crowned, within branches
